_comment: Merge this entry into the `PostToolUse` array of ~/.claude/settings.json, alongside whatever already matches ExitPlanMode (it composes; it does not replace). The command points at a stable symlink (~/.claude/hooks/awm-reflection-mode.py) so the settings never change across deploys — retarget the symlink at the service's hooks/plan_mode_hook.py (release tree on prod, a worktree copy while iterating). `|| true` keeps a missing or broken hook silent: it must never affect a turn. The timeout must exceed the hook's own retry budget (~16s), or Claude Code kills it mid-POST.
